const j=$('Build Follow-Up LLM Request').item.json; let raw=$json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content||''; let p={}; try{p=JSON.parse(raw)}catch(e){p={body:raw}}; return [{json:{...j,body:String(p.body||''),recipientEmail:j['Contact Email'],expectedEmail:j['Contact Email'],emailVerified:j.emailVerified,minWords:60,maxWords:100,mode:'FOLLOW_UP'}}];

parameters.jsCode: const base=$('Prepare Follow-Up Approval Context').item.json; const resumed=$json; const decision=String(resumed.query?.decision??resumed.params?.decision??resumed.body?.decision??'').toLowerCase(); const approved=decision==='approve', rejected=decision==='reject'; return [{json:{...base,...resumed,approvalDecision:approved?'approved':rejected?'rejected':'timed_out',approved,approvalTimestamp:new Date().toISOString()}}];
